name: the check counts the pairs of the cursor's record within its net offset
replace: walk(b) == Sum({t \in new : t[3] = b /\ Unnetted(t)})
walk(b) == Sum({t \in new : t[3] = b /\ t[1] >= cursor})

name: the check counts the copies of records before the cursor
replace: walk(b) == Sum({t \in new : t[3] = b /\ Unnetted(t)})
walk(b) == Sum({t \in new : t[3] = b /\ (t[1] # cursor \/ t[2] > off)})

name: the check ignores the records past its copy
the check ignores the copies of earlier views
replace: walk(b) == Sum({t \in new : t[3] = b /\ Unnetted(t)})
walk(b) == Sum({t \in Tuples(start, last) : t[3] = b /\ Unnetted(t)})
